ईश

ĪŚA . A Viśvadeva. (Universal deva). (M.B. Anuśāsana Parva, Chapter 91, Verse 31).

ईशान

ĪŚĀNA (śiva) . īśāna, with matted hair rides on the ox. See under śiva. (agni purāṇa, Chapter 51).

ईशानाध्युषीत तीर्थ

ĪŚĀNĀDHYUṢĪTA TĪRTHA . An ancient tīrtha. Tasting the water of this tīrtha will give all the benefits of the horse sacrifice. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 84, Verses 8, 9).
